title: Dialogues
subtitle: A2 · Unit 10: Food, shopping and quantities

steps.title: Dialogues
steps.body: Listen for what each person wants, the amount and the reason for a choice. When a food name is already clear, listen for en and the quantity that follows it.

steps.title: Plan the shared meal
steps.body: Karim and Nadia prepare a meal for a small study group.

examples.fr: Combien de lentilles faut-il pour le repas ?
examples.en: Nadia: How many lentils are needed for the meal?

examples.fr: Un paquet suffit. J'en prends un.
examples.en: Karim: One packet is enough. I will take one.

examples.fr: J'en prends six, puis une conserve pour la sauce.
examples.en: Karim: I will take six, then a tin for the sauce.

examples.fr: La liste indique du lait végétal.
examples.en: Nadia: The list says plant-based milk.
Karim: All right, I will take a litre of it.

examples.fr: Le reçu détaillé est dans le sac.
examples.en: Nadia: The itemized receipt is in the bag.

examples.fr: Je vérifie le prix au kilo avant de choisir les fraises.
examples.en: Karim: I will check the price per kilogram before choosing the strawberries.

steps.title: Check a food preference
steps.body: A student checks a product label before buying it for a class meal.

examples.fr: Le plat préparé convient-il à ton régime alimentaire ?
examples.en: Karim: Does the prepared dish suit your diet?

examples.fr: Je vérifie la liste d'ingrédients. Y a-t-il une option sans noix ?
examples.en: Nadia: I am checking the ingredient list. Is there a nut-free option?

examples.fr: Oui, il y en a une ici.
examples.en: Karim: Yes, there is one in this row.

examples.fr: Je vais en prendre deux pour le groupe.
examples.en: Nadia: I am going to take two of them for the group.
Karim: Do you also want bread?

examples.fr: Non, je n'en prends pas aujourd'hui.
examples.en: Nadia: No, I am not taking any today.

examples.fr: Le produit est en promotion. Je vérifie la date.
examples.en: Karim: The product is on special. I am checking the date.

examples.fr: La date limite est dans quatorze jours.
examples.en: Nadia: The best-before date is in two weeks.
Karim: Perfect. I will take one package of it.

steps.prompt: How many lentils does Karim take?
steps.explain: He says one packet is enough and that he will take one.

steps.prompt: How many tomatoes does Karim take?
steps.explain: He says he will take six tomatoes.

steps.prompt: What does Karim check before choosing strawberries?
steps.explain: He says he will check the price per kilogram.

steps.prompt: Why does Nadia check the ingredient list?
options: To find an option without nuts
To find a lower price per kilogram
steps.explain: She asks whether there is a nut-free option after saying she is checking the list.
